items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I couldn't remember ever having seen Bessie Smith in person, much less having appeared on a bill with her

ctx.x: So you remember, we talked about this before and I couldn't remember ever having seen Bessie Smith in person, much less having appeared on a bill with her, and this same Playbill had also been in somebody else's book -- I'd been familiar with it for a number of years before the Chris Albertson book.

But John Hammond at that time, as I said, was interested in my band, helping me --and he was also interested in Bessie Smith and it might have had something to do with her being billed there with me. About 2 or 3 months ago, John was out in California, with the Columbia Records convention, and we had dinner together. And I asked John about this. "What happened?" I said -- "I don't remember appearing with Bessie Smith." He said, "Oh, you were billed, but she didn't show up."

And as I recall now, in the book, I believe that Chris Albertson said that she had sort of a penchant for not showing up at all times, you know, when she was billed somewhere, and this was probably one of those times when something happened that prevented her from showing up.
